description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy metrics across three measures: Final Accuracy, Δ Accuracy, and Initial Accuracy, with the x-axis representing Initial Confidence ranging from 0.88 to 1.00. The y-axis, labeled Accuracy, spans from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue line with circular markers, labeled Final Accuracy, shows a steady increase from approximately 0.95 to 1.0 as initial confidence increases. The green line with square markers, labeled Initial Accuracy, also increases from around 0.68 to 1.0, with a slight dip near 0.91. The orange dashed line with diamond markers, labeled Δ Accuracy, remains relatively flat, fluctuating between approximately 0.3 and 0.4, with a slight increase toward the end of the range. All three lines exhibit error bars, indicating variability in the data points.
